bagPolicy.summary: For safety and speed of entry, bags are discouraged at events. Purses up to 12” x 12” x 6” are allowed at designated X-ray entry points. Wristlets, clutches, or wallets 4” x 6” x 1.5” or smaller are permitted at all entrances.
allowed: Purses no larger than 12” x 12” x 6”
Wristlet, clutch or wallets 4” x 6” x 1.5” or smaller
bagPolicy.note: Medical and parenting bags are permitted and subject to X-ray screening.

parking.note: Parking is available at RiverCentre and Kellogg Parking Ramps, both connected to the arena. Event day parking is first come, first served, and ParkWhiz reservations are not available for these ramps.

rideshare.note: Use Gate 4 on 5th Street at the northeast corner of the arena for rideshare pickup and drop-off.

concessions.note: Grand Casino Arena offers a variety of food and drink options including traditional sausages, craft beers, pizza, burgers, and more. Special offerings include the Wild $6 Happy Hour and the Wild Market with Amazon’s Just Walk Out technology. Alcohol sales end during the third period of Minnesota Wild games or one hour before the end of other events.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is on all levels and can be bought through Ticketmaster or the Box Office (651-726-8240). Wheelchair escorts to and from seats, free Telex assistive listening headsets (bring a photo ID), and sensory kits at Guest Services in section 105 are available. The accessible drop-off is at the southeast entrance (Gate 1).

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not allowed. If you leave the building during an event, you can't come back in, and entry requires a valid, unused ticket.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Grand Casino Arena Box Office is located in the main lobby at the southeast entrance of Grand Casino Arena (Gate 1). Box Office Summer Hours (May 18 through Labor Day)

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Gate 4 is at the northeast corner of the arena on 5th Street, between West 7th Street and Washington Street, and opens one hour before the ticketed start time. The Rice Park Entrance is at 145 West 4th Street, at Washington Avenue and 4th Street.
